reply_text:
I answered Tobias in a thread on his message in #inc-tansley-carrier-api: the depot was Southgate.

The source is this channel's own history from the incident on 3 Sep 2025. Priyanka posted that label printing had stalled at Tansley Parcel depots and that Southgate dispatch had totes stacked beside door 4. When she closed the incident, she said Southgate had cleared the backlog.

Nothing Tobias can see gives a street address or city for Southgate, and I told him that. There are no Tansley Parcel files in the share. I also warned him not to mix it up with the Tulsa hub, which comes up for Tansley Parcel in #central-team but was a separate login problem. I only read channels he's in and public files.
